question: Average cycle time from PSA intake to Pump on Body in Q1 2026, by channel and device type — which combination is fastest?
If we shift 15 percent of DME Mobi volume to DTC over Q2 and Q3, what happens to gross margin?

description: PSA-to-Pump-on-Body cycle time and claim volume by channel (certified).
Gross margin percent and dollars by channel, device, and region (certified).
Per-patient per-month recognized revenue (upfront and recurring), certified.
Consumable (recurring) revenue cohorts by channel, device, and lifecycle status.
Recognized revenue by channel, device, and quarter (certified).

content:
## Channel definitions
There are three sales channels:
  • DME — Durable Medical Equipment via Healthcare Providers
  • Pharmacy
  • DTC — Direct-to-Consumer

## Revenue recognition rules
Durables (pumps) recognize revenue upfront at the 'Pump on Body' milestone.
Consumables (infusion sets, cartridges) recognize revenue monthly on a recurring basis.

## Cycle time
Cycle time is the number of days from PSA (Patient Services Agreement) intake to the Pump on Body milestone.

## Gross margin
Gross margin = Margin USD / Revenue USD, expressed as a percentage.

## Term definitions
For detailed term definitions refer to the published Unity Catalog Page named 'Commercial Ontology'.

## Data governance
Only the five certified metric views in workshop_analytics are available. Do not attempt to query raw or sandbox tables. Patient Id is excluded; never surface individual patient identifiers.

question: What is the average cycle time from PSA intake to Pump on Body in Q1 2026 by channel and device type?

content:
SELECT
  Channel,
  `Device Type`,
  `Avg Cycle Time Days`
FROM MEASURE({{CATALOG}}.workshop_analytics.mv_fulfillment_rate,
  `Avg Cycle Time Days`)
WHERE Quarter = 1 AND Year = 2026
GROUP BY Channel, `Device Type`
ORDER BY `Avg Cycle Time Days` ASC

question: Which channel and device type combination had the fastest cycle time in Q1 2026?

content:
SELECT
  Channel,
  `Device Type`,
  `Avg Cycle Time Days`
FROM MEASURE({{CATALOG}}.workshop_analytics.mv_fulfillment_rate,
  `Avg Cycle Time Days`)
WHERE Quarter = 1 AND Year = 2026
GROUP BY Channel, `Device Type`
ORDER BY `Avg Cycle Time Days` ASC
LIMIT 1

question: What is the gross margin percent by channel for the most recent quarter?

content:
SELECT
  Channel,
  `Gross Margin Pct`
FROM MEASURE({{CATALOG}}.workshop_analytics.mv_gross_margin,
  `Gross Margin Pct`)
GROUP BY Channel
ORDER BY `Gross Margin Pct` DESC

question: Show total revenue by channel and device type in Q1 2026.

content:
SELECT
  Channel,
  `Device Type`,
  `Total Revenue USD`
FROM MEASURE({{CATALOG}}.workshop_analytics.mv_revenue_by_channel,
  `Total Revenue USD`)
WHERE Quarter = 1 AND Year = 2026
GROUP BY Channel, `Device Type`
ORDER BY `Total Revenue USD` DESC

question: What is total recurring consumable revenue by channel?

content:
SELECT
  Channel,
  `Total Consumable Revenue 12m`
FROM MEASURE({{CATALOG}}.workshop_analytics.mv_recurring_revenue,
  `Total Consumable Revenue 12m`)
GROUP BY Channel
ORDER BY `Total Consumable Revenue 12m` DESC

question: Compare upfront vs recurring revenue by channel in Q1 2026.

content:
SELECT
  Channel,
  `Total Upfront USD`,
  `Total Recurring USD`
FROM MEASURE({{CATALOG}}.workshop_analytics.mv_revenue_by_channel,
  `Total Upfront USD`, `Total Recurring USD`)
WHERE Quarter = 1 AND Year = 2026
GROUP BY Channel

question: What is the average monthly consumable spend per patient by device type?

content:
SELECT
  `Device Type`,
  `Avg Monthly Consumable USD`
FROM MEASURE({{CATALOG}}.workshop_analytics.mv_recurring_revenue,
  `Avg Monthly Consumable USD`)
GROUP BY `Device Type`
ORDER BY `Avg Monthly Consumable USD` DESC

question: Show me gross margin dollars and percent by region and device type.

content:
SELECT
  Region,
  `Device Type`,
  `Margin USD`,
  `Gross Margin Pct`
FROM MEASURE({{CATALOG}}.workshop_analytics.mv_gross_margin,
  `Margin USD`, `Gross Margin Pct`)
GROUP BY Region, `Device Type`
ORDER BY `Gross Margin Pct` DESC

question: How many patients reached Pump on Body in Q1 2026 by channel?

content:
SELECT
  Channel,
  `Patient Count`
FROM MEASURE({{CATALOG}}.workshop_analytics.mv_fulfillment_rate,
  `Patient Count`)
WHERE Quarter = 1 AND Year = 2026
GROUP BY Channel
ORDER BY `Patient Count` DESC

question: What is total fulfillment cost by channel and quarter in 2026?

content:
SELECT
  Channel,
  Quarter,
  `Fulfillment Cost USD`
FROM MEASURE({{CATALOG}}.workshop_analytics.mv_gross_margin,
  `Fulfillment Cost USD`)
WHERE Year = 2026
GROUP BY Channel, Quarter
ORDER BY Channel, Quarter
